description: The lines a CLI command prints while it waits for a session that another terminal has open, and when another terminal takes the session from it. Hand-written for the CLI cores. Every line goes to standard error. The animated form is used when standard error is a terminal and TERM is set and is not dumb; otherwise the plain form. The animated line is redrawn in place every frame_interval_ms: the command writes redraw_prefix, then the line, with no newline. A line longer than columns minus 1 Unicode code points keeps its first columns minus 2 code points and ends with an ellipsis; columns is the terminal width, or default_columns when it is unknown. When the command gets the session, it writes redraw_prefix to clear the animated line, then took_over_line and a newline. The plain form writes plain_waiting_line once when the wait starts and took_over_line once when it ends; the holder in plain_waiting_line is the first one seen. A command that gets the session at once prints none of these lines. The command asks again every retry_interval_ms. Ctrl-C while waiting clears the animated line and exits with interrupted_exit_code. since is the local time, HH:MM, of the lease's opened_at. elapsed is whole minutes, a colon, and two-digit seconds, counted from the start of the wait. A chat whose lease another terminal took prints lease_lost_line and exits with lease_lost_exit_code. A held lease counts as confirmed until the monotonic clock time at which its last successful acquire or renewal was sent, plus the TTL; the guard starts as soon as the acquire succeeds, before any takeover work, and a renewal call counts as failed after one renewal interval, a third of the TTL. When no renewal confirms it again before that time minus renewal_safety_margin_ratio times the TTL, the command stops pulling the session's task queue, stops the chat, prints lease_unconfirmed_line, and exits with lease_unconfirmed_exit_code, so the lease expires before another terminal can take the session.

templates.animated_waiting_line: {frame} Session {session_id} is open in another terminal ({holder}) · waiting {elapsed} · Ctrl-C to quit
templates.plain_waiting_line: Session {session_id} is open in another terminal ({holder}) · waiting · Ctrl-C to quit
templates.lease_lost_line: Session {session_id} is now open in another terminal ({holder}); this chat stopped.
templates.lease_unconfirmed_line: Session {session_id} could not renew its lease in time; this chat stopped so that another terminal can take the session.
